description: The plot illustrates the accuracy comparison of Experiment 1 (Ex1) and Experiment 2 (Ex2) during the embedding and LM head training stage. The x-axis is labeled “Steps”, has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 60000, and has tick labels at intervals of 10000. The y-axis is labeled “Loss”, has a logarithmic scale, ranges from 1x10⁻² to 1x10¹, and has tick labels at intervals of 1x10⁰.  A blue solid line with circle markers represents Ex1 End Loss, starting at approximately 0.98 at step 0 and decreasing to approximately 0.01 at step 60000. A green dashed line with square markers represents Ex2 End Loss, starting at approximately 1.30 at step 0 and decreasing to approximately 0.01 at step 60000. A blue solid line with diamond markers represents Ex1 Validation Loss, starting at approximately 1.10 at step 0 and decreasing to approximately 0.02 at step 60000. A green dashed line with triangle markers represents Ex2 Validation Loss, starting at approximately 1.20 at step 0 and decreasing to approximately 0.02 at step 60000.
